## Invitations

During the reporting period, 1857 invitations were issued to eligible residents in East City. A total of 678 people attended, representing a rate of 36.5 per cent. The attendance figure indicates that a substantial proportion of those invited took up the opportunity to attend. The outreach team will continue to monitor responses and identify any further opportunities to support attendance.

## Contact

SMS contact recorded 0, and reminders recorded 0. Staff continue to phone people who missed appointments, providing a direct opportunity to discuss attendance and any support required. This contact remains part of the follow-up approach for people who do not attend after receiving an invitation. Further outreach activity will be recorded as it is completed.

Prepared by G. Evans.
